resolvedFinding.before: parse_setting accepted empty exit-zero output as absent and could falsely confirm restoration.
resolvedFinding.after: Nonempty newline-complete UTF8 list, unique legitimate keys and configured default_input_method context anchor are required; context is tied to baseline before uninstall and to enable/restoration readbacks. Empty/malformed/missing/foreign anchors remain rejected. Literal target null is present and ineligible.

fixedSourceSemantics: SettingsService get prints returned String; printed null cannot distinguish absent value and literal string null.

list uses one provider.call, gets its array, sorts and prints each key=value line. There is no explicit footer; require complete bounded exit-zero command and context anchor. RemoteException throws; provider getAllSecureSettings builds a cursor under lock and only bluetooth_address has the separate accessibility special case. The target setting is @Readable.
put has no affirmative result text and ignores provider mutation result. Readback1 is mandatory; SettingsProvider may return false for restrictions/ownership.
delete targets the selected secure key/user and prints Deleted N rows; restoration relies on independently validated absence/value from the full list, not this text alone.
No TAG/default/overrideableByRestore/reset arguments are added. Restoration attests logical existence/value only, not provider metadata or immediate IME cache convergence.
controllerReview: Fixed same-emulator A then B, no ABAB or loop. Both arms call unchanged raw probe once and retain its complete fresh-install checks.

Only a complete comparable A (passed or primary RAW_POSITIVE_CALLBACK_NOT_OBSERVED) and cacheFALSE permits uninstall of its proven newly installed fixture; B then reinstalls identical APK/jar bytes and validates its own UID.
Original missing or string0 accepted; original1/literalnull/other values prohibit intervention. A/B setting, IME Configuration and post-dump cache state are distinct observations.
Original and mutation intent are atomically published and fsynced before enable command. A failed/timed-out write still obliges restoration.

Restore intent is persisted before its one write; finally temporarily clears only bounded_capture cancellation for restoration and restores the prior cancellation flag. Reinvocation does not repeat a restore after intent.

Restore and finalizer verify journal/source/original/baseline proof before the fixed old-value write, independently read back the settings list, and cannot claim confirmed after failure or empty output.

Interruption after restore intent may leave restoration unobserved and deliberately does not retry; outer workflow may run after emulator teardown. Documentation explicitly disclaims a guaranteed live-device fallback.
Arms preserve independent status and denominators; failed A is not relabeled by successful B, and restore failure prevents top-level pass.

Validation recomputes settings existence/value, sidecar states, summaries, original command bytes, ordering, source and APK/jar binding. Runtime input, AVD file and IME resource state remain separate layers.
inputParserReview: Selected EventHub and InputReader sections have unique ordered native/Java boundary headers, declared Reader count, exact fixed indentation, late per-device sentinels and Reader Configuration boundary.
Reader EventHub device0 resolves through BuiltInKeyboardId/aka marker; duplicate or missing associations are unavailable. Logical Reader IDs are not used as EventHub IDs.
Sources/KeyboardType/external/virtual/enabled are capabilities and associations only; missing keyboard/hardKeyboardHidden in this dump is explicitly NOT_PRINTED.
Whole service-tail completeness is delegated to command_ok and timeout/error rejection; selected section boundaries are not described as an atomic snapshot or proof of qwerty cause.

inputParserTests.scope: Independently run before final negative-builtin guard

remainingLimits: Synthetic validation only; no actual A/B device result yet.
Fixed order, warm IME and fixture reinstall/possibleUID change are disclosed confounds.
AVD file and one input-device snapshot do not prove continuous device identity or final IME Configuration cause.
Source tag/device image equivalence remains unverified.

resolvedNegativeBuiltinFinding.before: Malformed BuiltInKeyboardId=-2(NO_BUILT_IN_KEYBOARD) plus raw -2 aka0 and Reader raw0 could incorrectly be recorded.
resolvedNegativeBuiltinFinding.after: Alias annotation requires nonnegative builtIn and matching raw id; Reader raw0 resolution independently requires nonnegative builtIn.
resolvedNegativeBuiltinFinding.independentRecheck: Valid builtin still recorded; negative sentinel with or without aka annotation both unavailable.
